name: chip
title: Chip
description: A compact pill for a filter or selection you can remove. Multi-select tags and active filters.
docs: ATOM UIKit ships global BEM classes. CSS files MUST be imported in a global stylesheet (e.g. app/globals.css) — do not convert them to CSS Modules. Foundations (tokens/foundation) are not installed via this shadcn channel; use the Atom MCP or full DS setup for design tokens. Tuning ranges and gotchas: see meta.agent when present.

configurables.what: Surface style of the chip (outlined vs filled).
configurables.how: outlined for filters at rest; filled when selected. Default: outlined.

configurables.what: Padding and type scale of the chip.
configurables.how: s for filter bars; m for forms; xs only in dense tables. Default: s.
true when the filter is locked by plan or permissions. Default: false.

configurables.what: Error emphasis on the chip surface.
configurables.how: true only with an associated validation message. Default: false.

configurables.what: Forced focus ring for composed controls.
configurables.how: Prefer real :focus-visible; use focused only for composite widgets. Default: false.
true for filter UIs; false in static meta lists. Default: false.

gotchas.note: onClose must have an accessible name (aria-label on the close control).
variant prop is named type (not variant) — keep in sync with registry variantProp.

agent.usage:
import { Chip } from '@/components/atoms/Chip';

<Chip type="filled" size="s" onClose={() => {}}>
  Design
</Chip>
